#visualizing the data & the spike
```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/mayad/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/CelestialCelebs/maya_research")

```


```{r}

START_DATE <- as.Date("2015-01-01")
plot_spikes <- function(views_df, spikes_df, planet){
  ggplot(views_df,aes(x=date,y=views)) +
    geom_line(color="purple",linewidth=.4)+
    geom_point(data=spikes_df,aes(x=date,y=views),color="blue",size=3)+
    geom_text(data = spikes_df,
              aes(x=date,y=views,label=str_wrap(label,width=30)),
              hjust=-.1,vjust=1,size=3.5) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::comma,
                       expand=expansion(mult=c(.05,.2)))+
    labs(title=paste("Daily Wikipedia views for", planet),
         x="date",y="views per day")
}


```

```{r}
mars <- read_csv("mars_daily_views.csv")|> mutate(date=as.Date(date)) |>
  filter(date >= START_DATE)


mars_spikes <- read.csv("mars_spikes.csv") |> 
  mutate(across(c(date,start,end), as.Date),
    label=case_when(
    date == as.Date("2015-09-29") ~ "Signs were found that water once flowed on Mars",
    date == as.Date("2021-02-26") ~ "NASA's Preserverance Rover lands and spends its' first days on Mars"
  ))

plot_spikes(mars,mars_spikes,"Mars")

```
```{r}
venus <- read_csv("venus_daily_views.csv") |>
  mutate(date=as.Date(date)) |>
  filter(date >= START_DATE)


venus_spikes <- read_csv("venus_spikes.csv") |>
  mutate(across(c(date,start,end),as.Date),
         label="Scientists find phosphine in Venus' atmosphere, which is a potential sign of life + was involved in multiple different astronomical viewing events")

plot_spikes(venus,venus_spikes, "Venus")

```
